questions.question: In an election between two candidates, one person got 35% of the votes and lost by 6 votes. Assuming that there were no invalid votes, what was the total number of votes?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of votes received by losing candidate = 35%

Margin of loss = 6 votes

Calculation:

Let total votes = V

Votes received by losing candidate = 35% of V

Votes received by winning candidate = 65% of V

Margin = Votes received by winning candidate - Votes received by losing candidate

65% of V - 35% of V = 6

⇒ (65 - 35)% of V = 6

⇒ 30% of V = 6

⇒ dfrac{30}{100} times V = 6

⇒ V = dfrac{6 times 100}{30}

⇒ V = 20

**∴ The total number of votes is 20.**

questions.question: In a ration shop, there is a certain amount of cereals to distribute to 42 families for 15 days. If 48 kg of cereals can be distributed to 30 families for 7 days, then the quantity of cereals already in the shop was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cereals for 30 families for 7 days = 48 kg

Total families = 42

Total days = 15

**Formula used:**

Cereals required = frac{{Cereals for given families and days}}{{Families × Days}}

Total cereals = Cereals required × Total families × Total days

**Calculation:**

Cereals required for 1 family for 1 day = (48)/(30×7) = (48)/(210) = (8)/(35) kg

Total cereals required for 42 families for 15 days:

⇒ (8)/(35) × 42 × 15 = (8 × 42 × 15)/(35) = (5040)/(35) = 144 kg

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: In a circular race of 1100 m, P and Q start from the same point, at the same time and at speeds of 36 km/h and 63 km/h, respectively. When will they meet again for the first time on the track if they are running in the opposite direction?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Track length = 1100 m

Speed of P = 36 km/h = 36 × (1000/3600) = 10 m/s

Speed of Q = 63 km/h = 63 × (1000/3600) = 17.5 m/s

P and Q are running in opposite directions.

**Formula used:**

Relative speed when running in opposite directions = Speed of P + Speed of Q

Time to meet = Track length / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 10 + 17.5 = 27.5 m/s

⇒ Time to meet = 1100 / 27.5

⇒ Time to meet = 40 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 5 years.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Effective Interest % = Rate × Time = 7% × 5 = 35%

Simple Interest = 35% of Principal = 0.35 × 3500

Simple Interest = 35 × 35 = 1225

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1225.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Principal (P) = ₹3500

Rate of interest (R) = 7% per annum

Time (T) = 5 years

Formula used: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f22888986432ca6647489e8bd77b8722a9d0d2dc833ebda642b409300277963.png] 

Calculations:

⇒ SI = (3500 × 7 × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (3500 × 35) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 35 × 35

⇒ SI = 1225

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1225.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

Amount (A) is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest. A = P + SI = P × (1 + RT/100).

Calculating Rate or Time

From the SI formula, Rate (R) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T) and Time (T) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R).

Constant Interest Property

In Simple Interest, the interest earned remains the same every year because the principal remains unchanged throughout the duration.

questions.question: The LCM of 3, 4 and 5 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers: 3, 4, 5

**Formula used:**

LCM (Least Common Multiple) is the smallest number that is divisible by all given numbers.

**Calculation:**

Prime factorization:

3 = 3

4 = 2 × 2

5 = 5

LCM is obtained by taking the highest powers of all prime factors:

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM = 4 × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM = 60

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: The mean of five numbers is 55. If one of the numbers is excluded, the mean gets reduced by 5. Which of the following is the excluded number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The mean of five numbers is 55.

One number is excluded, and the new mean is reduced by 5, i.e., the new mean is 55 - 5 = 50.

**Formula used:**

Mean = Total Sum / Number of Numbers

**Calculations:**

Total sum of five numbers = 55 × 5 = 275

Total sum of remaining four numbers = 50 × 4 = 200

Excluded number = Total sum of five numbers - Total sum of remaining four numbers

⇒ Excluded number = 275 - 200

⇒ Excluded number = 75

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: If the total surface area of a hemisphere is 192π cm², then the radius of the base of the hemisphere is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere = 192π cm²

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere = 3πr²

Where, r = radius of the base

**Calculation:**

192π = 3πr²

⇒ r² = 192π ÷ 3π

⇒ r² = 64

⇒ r = √64

⇒ r = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: A famous basketball league team is planning to paint the entire basketball shaped dummy whose radius is 7 m. A painter is hired who tells that 5.4 liters of paint will be used to paint the area of 36 m². How much paint (in l) is required? (round of to one decimal place) Take pi = frac{22}7
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area of spherical dummy = 4 × π × r²

⇒ Area = 4 × (22/7) × 7² = 616 m²

Amount of paint used per m² = 5.4 ÷ 36 = 0.15 l/m²

Total paint required = 616 × 0.15 = 92.4 l

**∴ The correct answer is 92.4 l.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the spherical dummy (r) = 7 m

Paint used for 36 m² area = 5.4 l

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a Sphere = 4 × π × r²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0169af09a5ac2f104bf0242d1e19a6f638afd2dfc4524b6cf325da22a3d06abd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × 7 × 7

⇒ Total Surface Area = 4 × 22 × 7 = 616 m²

⇒ Paint required for 1 m² = 5.4 ÷ 36 = 0.15 l

⇒ Total paint required = Area × Paint per m²

⇒ Total paint required = 616 × 0.15 = 92.4 l

**∴ The correct answer is 92.4 l.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a full sphere is given by the formula V = (4/3) × π × r³.

Surface Area of a Hemisphere

A solid hemisphere has a Curved Surface Area = 2 × π × r² and a Total Surface Area = 3 × π × r².

Volume of a Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half of a full sphere, given by V = (2/3) × π × r³.

questions.question: A cylindrical glass with a diameter of 20 cm is having the juice to a height of 9 cm. An ice cube of size 8 cm is amereced in it completely. How much will the juice level rise in the glass? (Use π = 3.142 and answer correctly up to the nearest mm)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the cylindrical glass = 20 cm

Radius (r) of the cylindrical glass = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm

Initial height of juice = 9 cm

Side length of the ice cube = 8 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

Volume of a cube = side³

Change in height of the juice = Volume of ice cube ÷ Base area of the cylinder

**Calculation:**

Volume of the ice cube = side³

⇒ Volume of the ice cube = 8³ = 512 cm³

Base area of the cylinder = πr²

⇒ Base area = 3.142 × 10² = 3.142 × 100 = 314.2 cm²

Change in height of the juice = Volume of ice cube ÷ Base area of the cylinder

⇒ Change in height = 512 ÷ 314.2

⇒ Change in height ≈ 1.63 cm = 16.3 mm

**∴ The juice level will rise by approximately 16 mm. The correct answer is option (3).**
